title: Auddia Inc. 8-K Filing
summary: Auddia Inc. (AUUD), a small-cap technology company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, announcing a public offering of common stock and warrants expected to raise approximately $12 million in gross proceeds. The company is offering 1,405,006 shares of common stock at $2.36 per share along with pre-funded warrants and common warrants. This is a routine micro-cap equity financing event with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Auddia Inc. commenced a public offering on April 24, 2026 for 1,405,006 shares of common stock
Pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 3,679,737 shares at $2.36 minus $0.001 exercise price
Common warrants to purchase up to 5,084,743 shares at $2.36 exercise price, expiring in 5 years or upon merger completion
Expected gross proceeds of approximately $12 million; net proceeds approximately $10.9 million
Placement agent Dawson James Securities will receive a 7.0% cash fee on gross proceeds
Company is an emerging growth company incorporated in Delaware, headquartered in Boulder, CO
